task.title: Stop hiding unknown-status tasks on the web board
task.description:
A task whose status has no column disappears from the web board entirely, while the terminal board shows it under an explicit heading. The two boards disagree about whether to be honest.

The client render() drops any task whose status has no column (internal/webui/assets/index.html:1800-1803, deliberate per TestHandlerClientBoardIgnoresUnknownStatuses at internal/webui/handler_test.go:3856), and the server template renders only .Board.Columns and never Board.UnknownTasks (index.html:214-219). The terminal renderer emits an UNKNOWN STATUS section (internal/terminalui/render.go:138-141, 240-252). The presentation layer computes the unknown set for both.

This becomes reachable the moment two people run different Workbook versions against one remote, which is what a beta produces, and it is on the direct path of two Ready tasks: per-project custom status columns and removing the default Blocked status. Both create task states one client knows and another does not. A task that is invisible rather than merely unsorted is a task a user believes was deleted.

Acceptance:
- The web board surfaces tasks whose status matches no column, in a clearly labeled area consistent with the terminal renderer.
- The behavior is covered by a client test, replacing the current test that pins the hiding.
- The intentional parity decision between the two renderers is documented so the next change keeps them aligned.
